text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now coming down the hill into the 4th 
corner! The lead Umamusume is holding on, 
digging deep!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...! I'll push forward... with all my 
might...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(I have no more doubts about my running. 
There's nothing... left to fear!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(—The stage was supposed to finally be 
set. I gained a fully healthy body, so 
that we could have a true serious match in 
a G1.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Still, this time, you're the one taking a 
break.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...Fate can be so cruel. Causing our 
paths to cross like this...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (Still—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(Your speed is burned into the back of my 
eyelids.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: (—You are always running ahead of me.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...
choice_data_list: Laurel, that was a great run!
Laurel, that was a great run!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm quite exhausted. As expected 
of... 3,200 meters at Yodo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To get this worn out... I still have... 
plenty of room for improvement... don't 
I...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if Brian-chan were running... 
surely—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Far ahead of me. She should have reached 
beyond the winning post by now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel points toward the far end of 
the course she had just run through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflected in her eyes is the back of the 
"strongest," who isn't even here.
choice_data_list: She gets stronger with every race she runs

She gets stronger with every race, doesn't 
she?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. If I'm going to catch up to her, I 
can't afford to fall behind in growth rate 
either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I—can still get so much stronger!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Fuhaa~~ââ â Tenno Sho (Spring), 
MARVELOOOUSâ ââ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I had no idea who was going to 
win! It was soo thrilling☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Still... heheh.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mabe-chin! Maya knows about something 
super-duper sparkly that's even way more 
amazing than this!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "Ooh~☆★ Mayano's eyes are sparkling~☆★"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ Right? Maya's gonna give it her all 
in the Classics too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder if we can run together at the 
end of the year~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: HRAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: American Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Now THAT was a race! Keep this up, and 
you'll be unstoppable!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha, yeah right.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Like I could ever beat Brian with running 
of this level. I haven't even... felt any 
real response yet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's run it back! Come on, one 
more 1-on-1!

text_block_list.name: American Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! Show me what you got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if the Tenno Sho (Spring) comes to an 
end, spring is far from over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The buds of everyone's feelings continue 
to swell toward their time of blooming.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day after the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
during Sakura Laurel's training...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hah... Hah... ...Hah... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel has great potential. What 
race is she running in next?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I knew it. She's gonna become a total 
monster. Sheesh... There's no tellin' who 
the favorite is this year!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Even my editor was saying so! The Classic 
generation is packed with talent, enough 
to give it some kind of special name!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, if it's come to that, then the 
centerpiece of this era is...

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
It's gotta be Narita Brian, right? 
Definitely Brian. It's Narita Brian, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
"Man! I really hope Brian comes back soon! 
Rumor has it she might return this autumn, 
though."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Autumn, huh... Guess she's planning to be 
ready in time for the Autumn Shield her 
sister missed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Autumn.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Since we ran in the 'Spring 
Shield', shouldn't we enter the 'Autumn 
Shield' too?
choice_data_list: When you think of the autumn shield...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn). A medium-distance 
GⅠ held at Tokyo Racecourse, where racers 
contend for the prestigious Autumn Shield.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure Brian-chan will heal from her 
injury and make a comeback in no time.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Besides, even if my return gets delayed 
worst comes to worst, the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) is a race I still want to aim 
for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn), speed will 
matter, but toughness to withstand the 
final duel will also be required.
choice_data_list: Let's go, so we can become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we set our sights on our next 
goal: the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
